examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A successful run of a function: the root span, its steps indented under it and the origin fetch with its own children, each drawn as a bar against the run's clock. Search narrows the rows, a parent row expands and collapses, and selecting a row opens its details.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Trace from '@aziontech/webkit/trace'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const spans = [
    { id: 'root', name: 'image-resizer', service: 'Function', start: 0, duration: 412 },
    {
      id: 'parse',
      parentId: 'root',
      name: 'parse-request',
      service: 'Compute',
      start: 4,
      duration: 12
    },
    {
      id: 'origin',
      parentId: 'root',
      name: 'fetch-origin',
      service: 'Network',
      start: 16,
      duration: 186
    },
    {
      id: 'dns',
      parentId: 'origin',
      name: 'dns-lookup',
      service: 'Network',
      start: 16,
      duration: 14
    },
    {
      id: 'tls',
      parentId: 'origin',
      name: 'tls-handshake',
      service: 'Security',
      start: 30,
      duration: 31
    },
    {
      id: 'response',
      parentId: 'origin',
      name: 'origin-response',
      service: 'Network',
      start: 61,
      duration: 141
    },
    {
      id: 'decode',
      parentId: 'root',
      name: 'decode',

    {

    {
      id: 'cache',

  ]

  const selected = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <Trace
    v-model:selected="selected"
    :spans="spans"
    aria-label="Trace of the test run"
  />
</template>

examples.name: WithError
examples.summary: A failed run: the span that timed out and the parents it failed are danger bars with an error icon, and the selected span shows its Failed tag and the one-line reason.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Trace from '@aziontech/webkit/trace'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const spans = [
    {
      id: 'root',
      name: 'image-resizer',
      service: 'Function',
      start: 0,
      duration: 1240,
      status: 'error',
      message: 'The run failed because the origin did not answer.'
    },
    {
      id: 'parse',
      parentId: 'root',
      name: 'parse-request',
      service: 'Compute',
      start: 4,
      duration: 11
    },
    {
      id: 'origin',
      parentId: 'root',
      name: 'fetch-origin',
      service: 'Network',
      start: 15,
      duration: 1201,
      status: 'error',
      message: 'No response within the 1 s read budget.'
    },
    {
      id: 'dns',
      parentId: 'origin',
      name: 'dns-lookup',
      service: 'Network',
      start: 15,
      duration: 12
    },
    {
      id: 'tls',
      parentId: 'origin',
      name: 'tls-handshake',
      service: 'Security',
      start: 27,
      duration: 34
    },
    {
      id: 'response',
      parentId: 'origin',
      name: 'origin-response',
      service: 'Network',
      start: 61,
      duration: 1155,
      status: 'error',
      message: 'Read timed out after 1,000 ms.'
    }
  ]

  const selected = ref('response')
</script>

<template>
  <Trace
    v-model:selected="selected"
    :spans="spans"
    aria-label="Trace of the failed run"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Selected
examples.summary: A selected span with its details: service, start, duration, share of the run and its attributes (method, URL, status code).
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Trace from '@aziontech/webkit/trace'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const spans = [
    { id: 'root', name: 'checkout-handler', service: 'Function', start: 0, duration: 268 },
    {
      id: 'session',
      parentId: 'root',
      name: 'read-session',
      service: 'Storage',
      start: 6,
      duration: 22,
      attributes: { 'kv.namespace': 'sessions', 'kv.hit': 'true' }
    },
    {
      id: 'price',
      parentId: 'root',
      name: 'price-cart',
      service: 'Compute',
      start: 30,
      duration: 64
    },
    {
      id: 'payments',
      parentId: 'root',
      name: 'call-payments',
      service: 'Network',
      start: 96,
      duration: 158,
      attributes: {
        'http.method': 'POST',
        'http.url': 'https://payments.example.com/v2/charges',
        'http.status_code': 201,
        'net.peer.region': 'sa-east'
      }
    }
  ]

  const selected = ref('payments')
</script>

<template>
  <Trace
    v-model:selected="selected"
    :spans="spans"
    aria-label="Trace of the checkout run"
  />
</template>
